difficulty_reason: The dense-orbit theorem restricts arithmetic height growth to cohomological Lyapunov multipliers for surjective endomorphisms, using Moriwaki heights, numerical degree inequalities and a lift of the cohomological action from N1 to Picard groups. The full normal-projective/finitely-generated-model setting and dense-orbit hypothesis are retained. It does not identify the degree with the largest multiplier; dynamical Mordell-Lang applications are context, not additional counts.
